description: PENDING - the COBOL-2023 INITIALIZE category-name MESSAGE-TAG (ISO 14.9.20.2; ISO 8.9 reserves MESSAGE-TAG from 2023, Annex E.2 item 25). The GATE is live and named from the VersionConformancePass parse arm exactly like its 2002/2014 siblings; the row is pending because no PROGRAM can exercise the ACCEPT side. 14.9.20.3 SR3 requires identifier-2 for a MESSAGE-TAG category-name and SR4 requires that `SET <message-tag item> TO identifier-2` be valid, so a conforming use needs a message-tag DATA ITEM - and the A.4 message-control facility is owner-declined (docs/CONFORMANCE.md 4), so no such item can be declared and every MESSAGE-TAG REPLACING item is refused COBOL1983. Activation is owned by the MCS facility decision, not by this lane. kb/Work PB415.
vcr: 2023 introduction (ISO Annex E.2 item 25 = VCR row 32, the MESSAGE-TAG reserved word)
